replication_unit: campaign; shared Docker Desktop session, new server containers, same bridge, same resource configuration

statistics.point_estimate: median of ten campaign medians; contrasts: median of ten within-campaign paired median differences
statistics.within_campaign_bootstrap: 2000 resamples retained as secondary in campaign-*/comparisons.csv
statistics.instability: at least two positive and two negative campaign effects
statistics.outliers: Tukey 1.5 IQR within each campaign/scenario; none removed
statistics.cv: sample SD / mean of ten campaign medians, percent

implementation_changes: Only isolated s_client setup wall/CPU wrappers; original protocol sources, fixtures and libraries unchanged
setup_scope: compact_client or mtc_client, including configuration load, prior validation and callback registration; before SSL_new/handshake; nested setup logging included; PAPER_SETUP output itself excluded

byte_definitions.transport: TLS BIO bytes through client handshake-done, no network headers or retransmissions
byte_definitions.certificate_verify: TLS handshake header plus body; not a Merkle proof
byte_definitions.mtc_inclusion_proof: hash array payload excluding vector length
byte_definitions.mtc_checkpoint: zero in TLS; separate OOB trust file
byte_definitions.mtc_landmark_reference: 12 bytes MTCProof start/end; no explicit landmark number in certificate
byte_definitions.mtc_predistributed: entire local landmark configuration file, including trust keys/signatures

additional_accounting.predistributed_bytes: total local trust configuration file bytes, including CA material; PEM for compact/X509, binary MCF1 for MTC; not network transport
additional_accounting.predistributed_incremental_bytes: signed root for compact warm; trust.bin minus authority.bin for MTC landmark
additional_accounting.trust_validation_ms: compact warm: root signature operation only; MTC landmark: checkpoint signatures only; nested within setup; cold blank if not separately timed
additional_accounting.root_setup_ms: alias for full compact configuration setup wall time
additional_accounting.mtc_proof_bytes: entire encoded MTCProof, including signatures if present
additional_accounting.mtc_checkpoint_oob_bytes: serialized checkpoint fields and signature vector in trust.bin
additional_accounting.mtc_landmark_bytes: complete trust.bin file, not TLS bytes
additional_accounting.signed_root_tls_bytes: root payload sent in compact cold only
additional_accounting.missing_values: empty CSV cells mean unmeasured/not applicable, never fabricated zeros

trust_cache: none; each new client process reloads and revalidates root/landmark
security_asymmetry: MTC standalone requires CA and one local cosigner; X509 has no SCTs. Compact/MTC comparisons are architectural, not protocol-equivalent.
preflight_harness_corrections: attempt 01: legacy C demos invoked without required fixture arguments
attempt 02: C/mtc_tests.c deliberately returns 1 on success; output/status-aware wrapper added; protocol untouched
